authoring_instructions:
idle-walk-attempt1 EXACT PROMPT:
Create a NEW transparent RGBA hand-painted 2D isometric game animation atlas based ONLY on the ONE dark green tentacle creature in the attached existing project portrait. This is newly authored articulated 2D motion, not recovered original animation. Preserve this source identity exactly: an upright tapered wrinkled olive/dark-moss-GREEN organic central body, ONE large VERTICAL BLACK FRONT MAW ringed with many fine GOLDEN/IVORY teeth, tiny red slit/spot details embedded down the body, numerous thick long green curling tentacles growing organically from the solid body. Rough mottled green skin and tan/gold edge highlights. Several large upper tentacles curl upward; lower heavy tentacles coil on the ground. No floating orb, octopus head replacement, human legs/arms, wings, staff, weapon, clothing, extra eyes or new objects. All tentacles remain connected to the central body; one coherent complete silhouette. Repaint clean silhouettes and do not copy damaged border pixels, stray neighbor fragments or hidden transparent RGB speckles.

STRICT LAYOUT: exactly EIGHT equal columns by FIVE equal rows = FORTY SMALL complete independently articulated full-body poses on one canvas. Every ENTIRE silhouette, including the widest curled tentacle tips, occupies at most 40-45 percent of BOTH its cell width and cell height. Huge transparent gutters and safe outer margins; no neighboring silhouettes or rectangular crop bounds overlap. Never clip a tip or disconnect an appendage. Fixed camera, identical original body/core scale and material across all40. Empty space fully transparent alpha0. No background, floor drawn, shadow, text, label, grid, aura, dust, glow cloud, detached particles or blood.

COLUMN DIRECTIONS left to right, held fixed down all rows: E = true RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE with front mouth at the right leading edge and visible side-body depth; SE = FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter toward screen lower-right; S = full FRONT toward viewer/down with vertical mouth centered; SW = FRONT-LEFT three-quarter toward screen lower-left; W = true LEFT-facing SIDE PROFILE with mouth at left leading edge; NW = BACK-LEFT away/upper-left; N = full BACK away/up, showing actual wrinkled rear organic body with NO front mouth or teeth visible through it; NE = BACK-RIGHT away/upper-right. Rear three-quarter views show rear body anatomy with front maw occluded. True side profiles have the maw seen narrow/edge-on, not a full frontal mouth pasted sideways. Correct SE/SW front and NW/NE back, not simple mirrored front views.

PHASE ROWS top to bottom:
ROW1 relaxed IDLE, heavy lower tentacles firmly PLANTED along a consistent implied ground baseline, upper tentacles loosely curled.
ROW2 distinct breathing IDLE: central body flexes, mouth subtly breathes, upper curls and lower support tentacles bend into visibly new curves while ground supports remain planted.
ROW3 CRAWLING WALK phaseA: leading lower tentacles reach forward along the column compass heading and PLANT, trailing lower tentacles brace behind as the central core leans forward. This creature crawls on its own tentacles, never hovers.
ROW4 CRAWLING WALK passing phaseB: planted leading tentacles pull the core forward, rear tentacles retract into compact loops, support contact remains on ground. Clearly different root bends and core lean from phaseA.
ROW5 CRAWLING WALK phaseC: opposite set of lower tentacles extends and plants ahead, first set trails/recoils, core sways oppositely; visible new joint curves and alternating support, not the same stance translated.

ALL40 must contain real organic articulation, substantial tentacle-curve changes and body lean. No scaled/translated/duplicated stills, no mirrored pseudo-frames. Keep body MASS and upper core proportions constant and lower support contact on a common cell baseline. This is a GROUNDED creature (floating FALSE): several lower tentacles always touch the implied floor, no airborne body, invented levitation or shadow. Keep all limbs connected and all complete bodies separated.
